title: Copy ordinary quoted-field text in spans
question: Can quoted serialization avoid per-scalar appends while preserving exact escaping?
summary: Span copying preserves encoded CSV bytes and retains a scoped native improvement with its negative control.

workloads: One million rich ordered-export records with Unicode, doubled quotes and embedded CRLF; separate ordinary pipeline controls.

validation.summary: Recorded eight-job comparison and semantic controls preserve escaping, encodings, strict caps and output parity on the tested settings.

limitations: Small development cells and uncontrolled cache/background state do not establish general device, shape or tail performance.
Historical percentage gains are not additive; every comparison uses its own pinned baseline.
Unreserved String growth is not claimed identical; no new buffer, worker or publication policy is introduced.
exclusions: Previous compact-field gains and the negative control are not pooled into the rich-field effect.
